description: The screen's floating centerpiece: total value + total equity, equity-% owned, and a stacked equity-vs-mortgage ownership bar. The ONE floating card on the Properties screen.

totalValue.description: Sum of effectiveValue across all properties (dollars)

totalEquity.description: Sum of (effectiveValue - debt_balance) across all properties

propertyCount.description: Number of properties, rendered as the '{n} homes' pill

loading.description: When true, render a Skeleton height=132 radius=radius.xl in place of content

derived.equityPercent: totalValue > 0 ? Math.round(totalEquity / totalValue * 100) : null  (hide %-owned + bar when null)

states: noMortgage (full-width equity bar, no mortgage legend)

accessibility.label: Portfolio: {propertyCount} homes. Total value {totalValue}. Total equity {totalEquity}, {equityPercent} percent owned.
